title: HVAC Distributor EDI for Mechanical Contractors: Track Equipment POs, Backorders, and Partial Receipts
summary: Map HVAC supplier EDI to equipment purchase lines and job allocations while preserving backorder and receiving decisions.
body_markdown:
## The operating decision


HVAC distributor EDI should preserve the relationship between equipment purchase lines, supplier acknowledgments, backorders, shipments and actual receipts. Mechanical contractors need this detail because an installation can depend on a small missing component even when the main unit has arrived. Map supplier and contractor item references, units and job allocations explicitly. EDI can report a changed promise or shipment; procurement and receiving still decide whether the change is acceptable and what physically arrived.
